title.zh: 为前任教育总监Fred W. Atkinson提供救济，授权将其某些未经法律授权的支出记入贷项的法案。
title.en: AN ACT FOR THE RELIEF OF FRED W. ATKINSON, LATE GENERAL SUPERINTENDENT OF EDUCATION, BY AUTHORIZING CREDIT FOR CERTAIN EXPENDITURES MADE BY HIM WHICH WERE NOT AUTHORIZED BY LAW.
title.orig: AN ACT FOR THE RELIEF OF FRED W. ATKINSON, LATE GENERAL SUPERINTENDENT OF EDUCATION, BY AUTHORIZING CREDIT FOR CERTAIN EXPENDITURES MADE BY HIM WHICH WERE NOT AUTHORIZED BY LAW.
title.vi: Luật cứu trợ Fred W. Atkinson, cựu Tổng giám thị Giáo dục, bằng cách cho phép ghi nhận một số khoản chi do ông thực hiện dù không được pháp luật cho phép.
title.th: กฎหมายให้ความช่วยเหลือ Fred W. Atkinson อดีตผู้อำนวยการการศึกษาทั่วไป โดยอนุญาตให้รับรองค่าใช้จ่ายบางรายการที่เขาได้จ่ายไปแม้ไม่ได้รับอนุญาตตามกฎหมาย
title.id: Undang-undang untuk memberikan bantuan kepada Fred W. Atkinson, mantan Pengawas Umum Pendidikan, dengan mengizinkan pengakuan atas pengeluaran tertentu yang dilakukannya meskipun tidak diizinkan oleh hukum.
title.ms: Akta memberi pelepasan kepada Fred W. Atkinson, bekas Penguasa Besar Pendidikan, dengan membenarkan pengiktirafan perbelanjaan tertentu yang dibuatnya walaupun tidak dibenarkan oleh undang-undang.

text.en:
The expenditure made by said Fred W. Atkinson as disbursing officer is hereby authorized and
ratified, and the Auditor for the Philippine Archipelago is hereby authorized and directed to credit the
account of said Fred W. Atkinson with the sum of one hundred and thirty-two dollars and eighty cents,
United States currency.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.

Enacted, July 30, 1903.
